fact: On 18 March 2025 the Trésor Pay platform for electronic payment of public services (ID card, passport, road fines) and the SIF/GUF land one-stop platform were presented, Trésor Pay already operational at some offices.
title: DIGITALISATION DE L'ADMINISTRATION : Deux nouvelles plateformes de modernisation lancées
